seo.title: Zynthian with OpenMixer's plugin host
seo.description: What OpenMixer's plugin host gives a Zynthian player: crash isolation, qualification, presets, MOD GUIs and measured figures against mod-host and jalv.

hero.title: A steadier plugin host for your Zynthian.
hero.lede: Plugins that cannot take the set down, menus built from what each plugin did on your device, and figures measured against mod-host and jalv.

intro.p1: OpenMixer's plugin host, plugin-hostd, runs the LV2 and CLAP plugins of a Zynthian in workers of their own. It works on a Raspberry Pi 4 or 5 with the Vangelis system and needs nothing from the OpenMixer console.
intro.p2: Below is everything it gives you, with the version each part shipped in. The guide has the install steps, the settings and the full tables.

zynthianHome.guide: Read the guide: install, use and settings
zynthianHome.figuresIntro: Each figure names the versions it was read with, and every comparison names mod-host and jalv.
